name: Sapphire of Aku'Mai
summary: Along Blackfathom Deeps, the naga are harvesting the glowing Sapphires of Aku'Mai. Water spirits cling to the crystals, and Je'neu Sancrea seeks help confiscating them before their arcane power can be exploited.

sections.title: Gems of the Deep
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps holds Sapphires of Aku'Mai in its watery cavern entrances along Ashenvale's Zoram Strand. Water spirits cling to the crystalline formations, rich in elemental energy, making them potent aids in magical workings. When scouts reported the subterranean naga quarrying the gems from cavern walls, Je'neu Sancrea, a shaman, sought adventuring help to confiscate them. In naga hands, the stones could fuel devastating arcane rites.

faq.q: What is a Sapphire of Aku'Mai?
faq.answer: Sapphires of Aku'Mai are vibrant crystals lining the walls of Blackfathom Deeps. Water spirits cling to them, giving the gems deep arcane and elemental resonance.

faq.q: Why are the naga collecting these sapphires?
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea suspects the naga intend to harness the crystals' water and arcane energies for dangerous sorcery in the submerged temple, though their exact intentions are uncertain.

faq.q: Who is looking for these sapphires?
aliases: who turns in essence of akumai
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea, an Earthen Ring shaman at Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's Zoram Strand, asks travelers to gather the sapphires and keep them from naga hands.

faq.q: Are these crystals directly tied to the beast Aku'mai?
faq.answer: The crystals take their name from Aku'mai, the monstrous hydra in the deeps, but grow naturally in the cavern walls. Their name reflects their nearness to the dark presence in the ruins.

angles.text: As an Earthen Ring shaman, you can sense the water spirits bound within these gems and see the naga harvest as a threat to the elements.
The sapphires' natural saturation with water makes them valued conduits for potent arcane components.
